resolvedFindings.counterexample: enqueue with revision=None committed a record, bypassing public CAS.
resolvedFindings.fix: All public revision-bearing methods require a non-bool integer. Internal maintenance/recheck paths alone may omit revision.
resolvedFindings.independentVerification: Eight-case negative suite checks None/bool/float/string/negative revisions across seven public entrypoints; rejected without traffic.

resolvedFindings.counterexample: enqueue then revoke and reallow without a sweep restored the original queued payload and delivered hello.
resolvedFindings.fix: Controller persists a client permissionEpoch; queued payload binds it. Revoke/reallow changes the epoch, so old payload cannot revive.
resolvedFindings.independentVerification: Original no-intermediate-sweep sequence and legacy clients lacking the field both remain revoked with no send.

resolvedFindings.counterexample: A synchronous transport callback calling owner_command attempted a second flock via a new fd and deadlocked despite RLock. Reviewer interrupted the isolated test process.
resolvedFindings.fix: An in_operation guard rejects same-thread API reentry immediately, including shutdown before it can release ownership.
resolvedFindings.independentVerification: Transport callback owner stop and shutdown both reject with message_api_reentry, retain ownership and holds, and make no wire effect.

additionalIntegrationChecks: Initial direct Controller disable during exchange could still deliver a payload. Such lower-level calls are now explicitly excluded from the public boundary; sole MessageAdapter owner/observe/attachment APIs serialize with dispatch. The implementation does not claim an instantaneous physical stop.
All public operations and shutdown share RLock; an already-waiting dispatch fails after shutdown closes the service, independently exercised with a held mutex.

MessageAdapter owns the same directory lifetime lock as LinuxGate; simultaneous IP/message sessions are rejected. Shared SQLite usage and retained reservations survive mode changes. Concurrent dual-path service remains unimplemented.
Constructor fences old state and reopening requires fresh authorization/observation. Independent reopen test retained the previous byte reservation.

Receiver frames cannot extend beyond the pinned policy expiry or be admitted after that period. This was statically found while the parent was already implementing its fix; no claim of an executed pre-fix reproduction.

Repeatable take plus durable acknowledge protects the handoff from consumer crash; independent restart/read, wrong-recipient, acknowledgement replay/conflict and replayed-frame checks pass. Consumer idempotent Job import remains a future trusted integration.

Exact signed envelope/base64 sizing, recipient/profile binding, reassembly aggregate size and digest, record/queue limits, retry/TTL bounds, new reservations for retries, unknown retention, and existing IP capability checks inspected.

MESSAGES.md distinguishes fixture/common protocol from modem driver, real network, RF, real AP authentication, provider billing and physical standalone acceptance; four display constraints remain explicit.

Independent focused negative cases; uses existing setup only

limits: Reviewer made no repository edits, Git mutations, provider calls, RF transmissions, VM operations or paid communication. Only independent scripts/logs/receipt were written under /private/tmp.

Production modem/provider transports, encryption and key provisioning, Broker/AP ingress, scheduler, country-specific services, real billing hard caps and physical hardware are not accepted by this review.

The transport must enforce all-traffic quota/expiry, perform no hidden retries/spooling and finish within a bound. Arbitrary callbacks cannot establish those guarantees. Stop waits for the current bounded exchange and must retry stale CAS before completion can be claimed.
Private storage anti-rollback, secure erasure and consumer idempotent Job import are explicitly outside this common adapter implementation.

Full repository verify, all access-adapter tests, real Linux packet regression, Git save, CI and main integration were not independently executed in this review. Parent-run results must remain separately attributed.
Receipt covers exact file hashes; later source edits require reinspection.
